passages.text: Then the man brought me into the outer sanctuary and measured the side pillars to be six cubits wide on each side.
passages.sermon:
A man led me into the outer sanctuary.
He measured the side pillars.
Each side pillar was six cubits wide.
The width of the tent matched the width of the side pillars.
passages.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־ הַהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־ הָאֵילִ֗ים שֵׁשׁ־ אַמּ֨וֹת רֹ֧חַב־ מִפּ֛וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ אַמּֽוֹת־ רֹ֥חַב מִפּ֖וֹ רֹ֥חַב הָאֹֽהֶל׃

passages.text: The width of the entrance was ten cubits, and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on each side. He also measured the length of the outer sanctuary to be forty cubits, and the width to be twenty cubits.
passages.sermon:
The man measured the entrance to the outer sanctuary.
The entrance was ten cubits wide.
Each side of the entrance was five cubits wide.
He measured the length of the outer sanctuary.
The length was forty cubits.
He measured the width of the outer sanctuary.
The width was twenty cubits.
passages.original: וְרֹ֣חַב הַפֶּתַח֮ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּוֹת֒ וְכִתְפ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔תַח חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מָד אָרְכּוֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: And he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the side pillars at the entrance to be two cubits wide. The entrance was six cubits wide, and the walls on each side were seven cubits wide.
passages.sermon:
A man led me into the inner sanctuary.
He measured the side pillars at the entrance.
Each side pillar was two cubits wide.
The entrance itself was six cubits wide.
The walls on each side of the entrance were seven cubits wide.
passages.original: וּבָ֣א לִפְנִ֔ימָה וַיָּ֥מָד אֵֽיל־ הַפֶּ֖תַח שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְהַפֶּ֙תַח֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֥חַב הַפֶּ֖תַח שֶׁ֥בַע אַמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then he measured the room adjacent to the inner sanctuary to be twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. And he said to me, “This is the Most Holy Place.”
passages.sermon:
A man stood near the inner sanctuary of the temple.
He measured the room next to the inner sanctuary.
The room was twenty cubits long.
The room was twenty cubits wide.
He spoke to me.
He said, “This is the Most Holy Place.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת־ אָרְכּ֜וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַֽהֵיכָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֖ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: Next he measured the wall of the temple to be six cubits thick, and the width of each side room around the temple was four cubits.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the wall of the temple.
The wall was six cubits thick.
He measured the side rooms around the temple.
Each side room was four cubits wide.
The side rooms surrounded the temple.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥מָד קִֽיר־ הַבַּ֖יִת שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְרֹ֣חַב הַצֵּלָע֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אַמּ֜וֹת סָבִ֧יב׀ סָבִ֛יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: The side rooms were arranged one above another in three levels of thirty rooms each. There were ledges all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms, so that the supports would not be fastened into the wall of the temple itself.
passages.sermon:
The temple had side rooms.
The builders arranged these side rooms in three levels.
Each level had thirty rooms.
Ledges went all around the wall of the temple.
These ledges supported the side rooms.
The supports did not go into the wall of the temple itself.
passages.original: וְהַצְּלָעוֹת֩ צֵלָ֨ע אֶל־ צֵלָ֜ע שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים פְּעָמִ֗ים וּ֠בָאוֹת בַּקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־ לַבַּ֧יִת לַצְּלָע֛וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִ֖יב לִהְי֣וֹת אֲחוּזִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ יִהְי֥וּ אֲחוּזִ֖ים בְּקִ֥יר הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: The side rooms surrounding the temple widened at each successive level, because the structure surrounding the temple ascended by stages corresponding to the narrowing of the temple wall as it rose upward. And so a stairway went up from the lowest story to the highest, through the middle one.
passages.sermon:
The temple had side rooms all around it.
These side rooms surrounded the temple.
The side rooms became wider at each higher level.
The temple wall became narrower as it rose upward.
The structure around the temple rose in stages.
Each stage matched the narrowing of the temple wall.
A stairway connected the stories.
The stairway went from the lowest story to the highest story.
The stairway passed through the middle story.
passages.original: וְֽרָחֲבָ֡ה וְֽנָסְבָה֩ לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה לַצְּלָע֗וֹת כִּ֣י מֽוּסַב־ הַ֠בַּיִת לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ לַבַּ֔יִת עַל־ כֵּ֥ן רֹֽחַב־ לַבַּ֖יִת לְמָ֑עְלָה וְכֵ֧ן הַתַּחְתּוֹנָ֛ה יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־ הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֖ה לַתִּיכוֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it, forming the foundation of the side rooms. It was the full length of a rod, six long cubits.
passages.sermon:
The temple stood on a raised base.
This base went all around the temple.
The base formed the foundation for the side rooms.
The base measured the full length of a rod.
The rod was six long cubits.
passages.original: וְרָאִ֧יתִי לַבַּ֛יִת גֹּ֖בַהּ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב מְיֻסְּדוֹת הַצְּלָעוֹת֙ מְל֣וֹ הַקָּנֶ֔ה שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת אַצִּֽילָה׃

passages.text: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick, and the open area between the side rooms of the temple and the outer chambers was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.
passages.sermon:
The temple had side rooms.
The outer wall of these side rooms was five cubits thick.
There was an open area between the side rooms and the outer chambers.
This open area was twenty cubits wide.
The open area surrounded the temple on all sides.
passages.original: רֹ֣חַב הַקִּ֧יר אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ לַצֵּלָ֛ע אֶל־ הַח֖וּץ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מֻנָּ֔ח בֵּ֥ית צְלָע֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַבָּֽיִת׃ וּבֵ֨ין הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת רֹ֣חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֛ה סָבִ֥יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: The side rooms opened into this area, with one entrance on the north and another on the south. The open area was five cubits wide all around.
passages.sermon:
The temple had side rooms.
These side rooms opened into an open area.
One entrance to the open area was on the north side.
Another entrance was on the south side.
The open area was five cubits wide all around.
passages.original: וּפֶ֤תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ לַמֻּנָּ֔ח פֶּ֤תַח אֶחָד֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפֶ֥תַח אֶחָ֖ד לַדָּר֑וֹם וְרֹ֙חַב֙ מְק֣וֹם הַמֻּנָּ֔ח חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Now the building that faced the temple courtyard on the west was seventy cubits wide, and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, with a length of ninety cubits.
passages.sermon:
The building stood on the west side of the temple courtyard.
This building faced the courtyard.
The building was seventy cubits wide.
The wall of the building was five cubits thick on every side.
The building was ninety cubits long.
passages.original: וְהַבִּנְיָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֶל־ פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה פְּאַ֣ת דֶּֽרֶךְ־ הַיָּ֗ם רֹ֚חַב שִׁבְעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְקִ֧יר הַבִּנְיָ֛ן חָֽמֵשׁ־ אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֖חַב סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאָרְכּ֖וֹ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Then he measured the temple to be a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.
passages.sermon:
A man measured the temple.
The temple was one hundred cubits long.
He measured the temple courtyard.
The courtyard was one hundred cubits long.
He measured the building and its walls.
The building and its walls were one hundred cubits long.
passages.original: וּמָדַ֣ד אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַגִּזְרָ֤ה וְהַבִּנְיָה֙ וְקִ֣ירוֹתֶ֔יהָ אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: The width of the temple courtyard on the east, including the front of the temple, was a hundred cubits.
passages.sermon: The temple courtyard was on the east side.\r\nThe front of the temple was also on the east side.\r\nThe width of the temple courtyard and the front of the temple together was one hundred cubits.
passages.original: וְרֹחַב֩ פְּנֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת וְהַגִּזְרָ֛ה לַקָּדִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃

passages.text: Next he measured the length of the building facing the temple courtyard at the rear of the temple, including its galleries on each side; it was a hundred cubits. The outer sanctuary, the inner sanctuary, and the porticoes facing the court, as well as the thresholds and the beveled windows and the galleries all around with their three levels opposite the threshold, were overlaid with wood on all sides. They were paneled from the ground to the windows, and the windows were covered.
passages.sermon:
The man measured the length of the building at the back of the temple.
This building faced the temple courtyard.
The building had galleries on each side.
The total length was one hundred cubits.
The outer sanctuary was part of this area.
The inner sanctuary was also included.
The porticoes faced the courtyard.
There were thresholds in the building.
There were beveled windows.
There were galleries all around.
The galleries had three levels.
These levels were opposite the threshold.
Workers overlaid all these parts with wood on every side.
They paneled the walls from the ground up to the windows.
They covered the windows.
passages.original: וּמָדַ֣ד אֹֽרֶךְ־ הַ֠בִּנְיָן אֶל־ פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־ אַחֲרֶ֧יהָ וְאַתּוּקֵיהָא מִפּ֥וֹ וּמִפּ֖וֹ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַֽהֵיכָל֙ הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְאֻֽלַמֵּ֖י הֶחָצֵֽר׃ הַסִּפִּ֡ים וְהַחַלּוֹנִ֣ים הָ֠אֲטֻמוֹת וְהָאַתִּיקִ֤ים׀ סָבִיב֙ לִשְׁלָשְׁתָּ֔ם נֶ֧גֶד הַסַּ֛ף שְׂחִ֥יף עֵ֖ץ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עַד־ הַֽחַלֹּנ֔וֹת וְהַֽחַלֹּנ֖וֹת מְכֻסּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary on all the walls, spaced evenly around the inner and outer sanctuary, were alternating carved cherubim and palm trees. Each cherub had two faces: the face of a man was toward the palm tree on one side, and the face of a young lion was toward the palm tree on the other side. They were carved all the way around the temple.
passages.sermon:
The temple had an inner sanctuary and an outer sanctuary.
The entrance to the inner sanctuary had space above it.
All the walls around both the inner and outer sanctuary had decorations.
Carvers made cherubim and palm trees on these walls.
They placed a palm tree between each cherub.
Each cherub had two faces.
One face of the cherub looked like a man.
This face was turned toward a palm tree on one side.
The other face of the cherub looked like a young lion.
This face was turned toward a palm tree on the other side.
Carvers made these designs all around the temple.
The designs covered every wall surrounding the temple.
passages.original: עַל־ מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֡תַח וְעַד־ הַבַּיִת֩ הַפְּנִימִ֨י וְלַח֜וּץ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הַקִּ֨יר סָבִ֧יב׀ סָבִ֛יב בַּפְּנִימִ֥י וּבַחִיצ֖וֹן מִדּֽוֹת׃ וְעָשׂ֥וּי כְּרוּבִ֖ים וְתִֽמֹרִ֑ים וְתִֽמֹרָה֙ בֵּין־ כְּר֣וּב לִכְר֔וּב וּשְׁנַ֥יִם פָּנִ֖ים לַכְּרֽוּב׃ וּפְנֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם אֶל־ הַתִּֽמֹרָה֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּפְנֵֽי־ כְפִ֥יר אֶל־ הַתִּֽמֹרָ֖ה מִפּ֑וֹ עָשׂ֥וּי אֶל־ כָּל־ הַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the outer sanctuary from the floor to the space above the entrance.
passages.sermon:
The outer sanctuary had walls.
People carved cherubim on these walls.
People also carved palm trees on these walls.
They carved from the floor up to the space above the entrance.
passages.original: מֵהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עַד־ מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֔תַח הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְהַתִּֽמֹרִ֖ים עֲשׂוּיִ֑ם וְקִ֖יר הַׄהֵׄיׄכָֽׄלׄ׃

passages.text: The outer sanctuary had a rectangular doorframe, and the doorframe of the sanctuary was similar.
passages.sermon: The outer sanctuary had a rectangular doorframe.\r\nThe sanctuary had a doorframe that looked the same.
passages.original: הַֽהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּזַ֣ת רְבֻעָ֑ה וּפְנֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה כַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃

passages.text: There was an altar of wood three cubits high and two cubits square. Its corners, base, and sides were of wood. And the man told me, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The altar stood in the sanctuary.
The altar was made of wood.
The altar was three cubits high.
The altar was two cubits long and two cubits wide.
The altar had wooden corners.
The altar had a wooden base.
The altar had wooden sides.
A man spoke to me.
The man said, “This is the table that is before the LORD.”
passages.original: הַמִּזְבֵּ֡חַ עֵ֣ץ שָׁלוֹשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת גָּבֹ֜הַּ וְאָרְכּ֣וֹ שְׁתַּֽיִם־ אַמּ֗וֹת וּמִקְצֹֽעוֹתָיו֙ ל֔וֹ וְאָרְכּ֥וֹ וְקִֽירֹתָ֖יו עֵ֑ץ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֚ה הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Both the outer sanctuary and the inner sanctuary had double doors, and each door had two swinging panels. There were two panels for one door and two for the other.
passages.sermon:
The temple had two main parts.
These parts were the outer sanctuary and the inner sanctuary.
Both the outer sanctuary and the inner sanctuary had double doors.
Each door had two swinging panels.
One door had two panels.
The other door also had two panels.
passages.original: וּשְׁתַּ֧יִם דְּלָת֛וֹת לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ וּשְׁתַּ֥יִם דְּלָת֖וֹת לַדְּלָת֑וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם מוּסַבּ֣וֹת דְּלָת֔וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם לְדֶ֣לֶת אֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דְלָת֖וֹת לָאַחֶֽרֶת׃

passages.text: Cherubim and palm trees like those on the walls were carved on the doors of the outer sanctuary, and there was a wooden canopy outside, on the front of the portico.
passages.sermon:
The doors of the outer sanctuary had carvings.
The carvings showed cherubim and palm trees.
The cherubim and palm trees looked like the ones on the walls.
A wooden canopy stood outside.
The canopy was in front of the portico.
passages.original: וַעֲשׂוּיָ֨ה אֲלֵיהֶ֜ן אֶל־ דַּלְת֤וֹת הַֽהֵיכָל֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִֽמֹרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשׂוּיִ֖ם לַקִּיר֑וֹת וְעָ֥ב עֵ֛ץ אֶל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאוּלָ֖ם מֵהַחֽוּץ׃

passages.text: There were beveled windows and palm trees on the sidewalls of the portico. The side rooms of the temple also had canopies.
passages.sermon:
The temple had a portico at its entrance.
The portico had sidewalls.
The sidewalls had beveled windows.
The sidewalls also had palm trees carved on them.
The temple had side rooms.
The side rooms had canopies.
passages.original: וְחַלּוֹנִ֨ים אֲטֻמ֤וֹת וְתִֽמֹרִים֙ מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֔וֹ אֶל־ כִּתְפ֖וֹת הָֽאוּלָ֑ם וְצַלְע֥וֹת הַבַּ֖יִת וְהָעֻבִּֽים׃
